newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's IMSA Q1 net profit falls.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's IMSA Q1 net profit falls.

text.p: Mexican conglomerate IMSA reported on Monday first quarter net profits of 445 million pesos, down some 26.7 percent compared to 607 million pesos during the same period of 1996.

IMSA's operating profits rose to 382 million pesos from 345 million pesos, the company said in a statement. It added that revenues rose 14 percent during the quarter on the year-ago period to 2.480 billion pesos.
Domestic sales were 1.438 billion pesos, up 8.3 percent compared to the first quarter of 1996. Export sales were 1.041 billion pesos, some 42 percent of the group's total sales, the company said.
The company's reported a financing gain of 105.52 million pesos versus a financing gain of 289.30 million pesos during the same quarter of the previous year.
